systems.name: GJ 644
systems.labelNote: C follows the published Gl 644 C designation for VB 8. D is the interface label for the fifth member Gl 643, whose source display name HD 152751C and CNS5 E label use other naming scopes. systems.name: Ross 458
systems.labelNote: Published C corrects the frozen CNS5 B designation for the wide T dwarf.

systems.name: Capella
systems.labelNote: Aa/Ab identify the giant pair; H/L retain the historical names of the wide M-dwarf pair. Do not label the H/L source A/B as the same pair as the giants.

systems.name: Chi Draconis
systems.note: The Table 5 masses use the paper orbital solution. Individual spectral types and blended photometry are withheld.

systems.name: Mu Cassiopeiae
systems.note: The faint secondary is a confirmed dM star. Retain already reviewed primary-only Bond et al. physical values; no third object is inferred.

systems.name: Chi1 Orionis
systems.note: The directly detected companion is stellar. Model age disagreements are retained as unknown individual ages.

systems.name: Zeta Herculis
systems.note: Published A/B membership is adopted. Calibration-dependent masses and a hypothetical unseen substellar companion are not adopted.

systems.name: Iota Pegasi
systems.note: Adopt component dynamical masses, without copying combined spectrum or photometry.

systems.name: HD 104304
systems.note: Resolved common-proper-motion companion. M4V and the 0.21 solar mass estimate are photometrically derived, not a resolved spectral or dynamical measurement.

systems.name: Gamma Cephei
systems.note: The orbit analysis identifies a stellar secondary. Its inferred M4 class and mass depend on the primary model and are withheld here. The planet remains outside this stellar-component card.

systems.name: Rigel
systems.note: Grade-5 MSC system A-(Ba,Bb,C); B is a spectroscopic pair, not one individual star. The visual C companion completes the quadruple. D is not admitted; the old proposed inner companion of A was contested.

systems.name: eps Ind
systems.note: Census B/C are resolved Ba/Bb. Existing MSC-generated component IDs are aliases of those same two brown dwarfs, not additional objects.
